PUBLIC NOTICE
SHERIFF’S SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION,
GLOUCESTER COUNTY
DOCKET NO.: F-005555-24
SHERIFF’S NO.: 24001443
Plaintiff:
DEUTSCHE BANK NATIONAL TRUST COMPANY, AS TRUSTEE FOR THE REGISTERED HOLDER OF MORGAN STANLEY HOME EQUITY LOAN TRUST 2007-2 MORTGAGE PASS THROUGH CERTIFICATES, SERIES 2007-2
Vs
Defendant:
WAYNE PASCHALL
By virtue of the above stated WRIT OF EXECUTION to me directed and delivered, issued out of the above stated Court, will be exposed for sale at Public Venue, on Wednesday, June 10, 2026, to-wit, at 2 o’clock in the afternoon prevailing time, at 1 N. Broad Street, Ceremonial Courtroom 201 in the City of Woodbury, County of Gloucester and State of New Jersey, all the following described real estate, that is to say:
Property being known as: 114 CARNATION DRIVE WOODBURY, NJ 08096 and BLOCK: 608 LOT: 29
THE PROPERTY TO BE SOLD IS LOCATED IN THE TOWNSHIP OF DEPTFORD IN THE COUNTY OF GLOUCESTER AND STATE OF NEW JERSEY
APPROXIMATE DIMENSIONS OF LOT: 153X163 IRR
NEAREST CROSS STREET: GOOD INTENT ROAD
ESTIMATED UPSET BID: $389,000.00 PLUS ANY ADDITIONAL SUMS AS ORDERED BY THE COURT
OCCUPANCY STATUS: OWNER OCCUPIED
*SUBJECT TO ANY UNPAID TAXES, MUNICIPAL LIENS OR OTHER CHARGES, AND ANY SUCH TAXES, CHARGES, LIENS, INSURANCE PREMIUMS OR OTHER ADVANCES MADE BY PLAINTIFF PRIOR TO THIS SALE. ALL INTERESTED PARTIES ARE TO CONDUCT AND RELY UPON THEIR OWN INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATION TO ASCERTAIN WHETHER OR NOT ANY OUTSTANDING INTEREST REMAIN OF RECORD AND/OR HAVE PRIORITY OVER THE LIEN BEING FORECLOSED AND, IF SO, THE CURRENT AMOUNT DUE THEREON.
2026 QTR 2 DUE: 05/01/2026 $2,184.38 OPEN
WATER: DEPTFORD MUA P.O. BOX 5506 DEPTFORD, NJ 08096 856-415-1111 ACCT: 9948 0 TO: 03/27/2026 $39.90 OPEN AND DUE 05/05/2026 $87.82 OPEN
SEWER: DEPTFORD MUA P.O. BOX 5506 DEPTFORD, NJ 08096 856-415-1111 ACCT: 9948 0 04/01/2026 - 04/30/2026 $40.50 OPEN AND DUE 05/05/2026 $81.00 OPEN
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn the sale without further notice through publication.
The approximate amount of the Judgment sought to be satisfied by said sale is $322,652.52
The purchaser must pay 20% of the purchase price in cash, certified check, cashier’s check, or treasurer’s check, balance to be paid within 30 days.
A deed to be delivered to the purchaser within 30 days from the date of sale, with lawful interest on the balance due, from the 11th day after sale, until the balance is paid.
Any eligible defendant/party interested in purchasing this property through the NJ Community Wealth Preservation Program set forth in NJ A5664 can find more information on our website at https://www.gloucestercountynj.gov/564/Foreclosure-Procedures.
Sales will begin promptly at 2:00pm. Please arrive shortly before this time to check in if you plan on bidding.
SURPLUS MONEY: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any persons claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person’s claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
Seized as the property of the Defendant, and taken in execution at the suit of the Plaintiff, and to be sold by
Carmel M. Morina,
Gloucester County Sheriff
Advertised online at: https://salesweb.civilview.com/Sales/SalesSearch?countyId=19
Date: April 27, 2026
Firm: RAS CITRON, LLC
Judgement Date: 10/18/2024
